notes: Beats 0-9 (hook through practice) were split and hand-tuned from the original 4-beat sheet using measured cut lengths across サンプル動画６/７/８ (the opening routine is identical, ~12-15s total, across all three) — see plan/daily-vlog-intro-fixed.md. They are marked "pinned": true so discover.ts orders them by this sheet's own `order` instead of source position, and never drops them for being short or low-importance. Re-running `npm run reference:beats` would overwrite this split with a fresh 4-ish-beat guess — regenerate beats 10-15 only, or re-apply the pinned split by hand afterwards.

beats.label: 冒頭フック（タイトル）
beats.description: Cold open. The creator is seated in his gaming chair holding a controller, mid-eFootball play, talking/reacting to the game. The usable framing is settled and fairly tight: his face AND the controller are both in frame. A multi-line title card is burned in over him, always starting with 'ウイイレ日本2位'. IMPORTANT: the raw footage almost always opens with several seconds of the camera being placed and framed — handheld wobble, his back, a half-empty chair, him leaning in and out of frame. That is never the hook; the hook starts after the framing settles and he is actually playing.

beats.description: One or two very quick shots, filmed wide from across the room with the bed, window and curtains in frame: him getting up off the bed / pulling back the blanket, and/or sitting up and reaching to open the curtain. This is ONLY the physical getting-up motion — it ends before he turns to face the camera and speaks. Do not include him talking to camera here; that is the next beat.

beats.label: おはようございます（カメラに向かって挨拶）
beats.description: He is now sitting upright on the bed, facing the camera directly and close enough that his face and upper body fill the frame, saying 'おはようございます'. A short single line to camera — comes right after he gets up (previous beat) and right before the longer, more energetic 'GENKIにいきましょー' call (next beat). Do not include the getting-up motion or the longer follow-up line in this beat.

beats.description: He brings the mug/bowl up toward his mouth and says 'いただきます' right before the first sip or bite, still facing camera. A short to-camera line — distinct from the actual swallowing/eating motion, which is the next beat.

beats.label: eFootball練習
beats.description: The long daily eFootball practice session: he sits at his desk or in his chair with a controller, playing, often with a smart-speaker clock visible. This beat is a TIMELAPSE — in the finished edit it is a couple of seconds of heavily sped-up footage, not a real-time slice, because the point is that it went on for an hour. So pick a LONG continuous stretch of him actually playing (tens of seconds), not a short representative moment, and caption it with the time RANGE it covered (e.g. '10:30〜11:30') rather than a single instant. Always follows directly after breakfast (おいしー!) in the running order.
